messages:
mina: hey team — Mina here, first day. running into a couple of onboarding bumps: after I approve the Okta push it shows an access error and my Google Drive hasn't appeared. also not getting SMS codes (i'm on a CN carrier). who should I ping for org provisioning / MFA workaround? :wave:

it-ops: welcome Mina! can you paste the exact Okta error (or screenshot)? and confirm your corporate email (alias/domain)?

mina: thanks. email is mina@redwood-cn.example.com (dot-alias). Okta shows: "You do not have permission to access this app (E0000007)". I approve the push on Okta Verify then it bounces. SMS to +86 139 0000 0000 is silent. tried the `Okta Verify` app and push both.

alex: pinging identity folks. @it-ops sometimes alias orgUnit mappings cause the Drive/1Password seat to lag. @okta-bot can you report provisioning status for that user?

okta-bot: Provisioning status for mina@redwood-cn.example.com: user created in Google Workspace, group sync: pending -> 1Password seat: pending. Last sync attempt: 2 minutes ago. Error: "orgUnitPath mismatch".

it-ops: yep that matches our usual pattern. looks like the alias landed in a different OU so group sync didn't assign apps. @jordan from IAM usually re-runs the OU mapping. jordan, can you re-run group sync for Mina? if not, we can temp-share Drive and enable backup codes.

jordan: on it. re-ran the sync but still blocked: the alias domain isn't listed in the allowed domains for that OU in GSuite. quick workaround — I just shared the onboarding Drive folder to your personal email and enabled passkey enrollment on your account. try the passkey flow: Chrome desktop > Account > Security > Use passkeys.

mina: i can see the shared folder invite now, thanks. tried passkey on my phone (Safari iOS) but it errors with "No platform authenticator available". my YubiKey is arriving tomorrow. SMS still not coming through.

alex: in CN we frequently route MFA with backup codes + passkey until carrier short codes are stable. i can enable backup codes and get a 1Password temporary shared item for Mina. @it-ops can you create backup codes and push via 1Password?

it-ops: generated backup codes and created a 1Password shared item named "onboarding/mina-mfa". invite sent to your personal email. confirm once you get it and if you can sign in with a backup code.

mina: got the 1Password invite and the backup codes, used one to complete Okta sign-in. thank you so much :rocket:

jordan: root cause fix: added the dot-alias domain to allowed domains for that OU and re-ran provisioning. 1Password seat shows active now and group sync completed. please verify Drive access.

mina: Drive is present and Okta device trust passes now. marking resolved — happy to share notes for future CN hires (carrier quirks, prefer passkeys/backup codes). should we add a short note to the new-hires doc?

alex: love that — i'll add a brief CN carrier note to onboarding checklist and include the passkey/backup-codes fallback. welcome aboard again, Mina! :thumbsup:
